name: Thermal / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A fast orange flame whoosh blooms then collapses into dry ember crackles and a soft charred crunch. Hot combustion release, short and physical.
